items.text: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
To kare angʼo momiyo Molek osekawo mwandu Gad?
Angʼo momiyo joge odak e dalane?"
mondo oked gi Raba mar jo-Amon;
Rwakuru lepu mag ywak kendo uywagi;
kaachiel gi jodolo mage kod jotelo mage.
Angʼo momiyo usungoru kuom holo mau,
igeno kuom mwandu magi kendo iwacho niya,
Ruoth, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho.
kendo onge ngʼama nochok joma noringo moke.
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho kuom Edom:
un joma odak Dedan, nimar anakel masira
ne Esau e kinde ma anakume.
Ka jopon olemb mzabibu obiro iru,
donge gibiro kwalo mwandu magu kaka ginyalo?
Nyithinde, wedene gi jomodak bute nolal nono,
bende nyalo keto geno mag-gi kuoma."
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: "Ka jogo ma ok owinjore omadh kikombe nyaka madhe, to angʼo momiyo ok anyal kumi? Ok initony ma ok okumi, to nyaka imadhe."
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, "Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, ni Bozra nokethi kendo nobed gir bwogo ji, gir jaro kendo nobed gir kwongʼ, kendo mieche duto nokethi chuth."
Asewinjo wach koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye kama:
Jaote oseor mondo owach ne ogendini niya,
e kind ogendini, kendo joma ijaro e dier ji.
un jogo modak e kind lwendni,
modak kuonde motingʼore gi malo mar got.
Kata obedo ni ugero uteu mabor ka od otenga,
jogo duto makalo bute nohum nono,
kendo gininyiere ka gineno adhondene duto."
e kaka en bende nobedi maonge
e bungu moyugno mar Jordan nyaka
anariemb Edom oa e pinye kadiemo wangʼ.
En ngʼa mowal manyalo yiero ne ma?
En ngʼa machalo koda kendo manyalo chungʼ koda?
Koso jakwath mane manyalo chungʼ koda?"
gima oseramo ni nyaka otimne joma odak Teman:
enoketh chuth kuondegi mag kwath nikech gin.
ywakgi nowinjre nyaka e Nam Makwar.
kendo piny koyaro bwombene ewi Bozra.
E odiechiengno chunje jolweny mag Edom
nochal gi chuny dhako mamuoch kayo.
kendo nigi chandruok ka nam mogingore.
kaka rem mar dhako mamuoch kayo.
dala maduongʼ mongʼere; dala mamor godo?
Adiera, joge matindo nopodh e yore;
jolweny mage duto nolingʼ thi odiechiengno,"
notiek kuonde mochiel motegno mag Ben-Hadad."
Kuom Kedar gi pinyruodhi mag Hazor, mane Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon omonjo:
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
mi utiek joma aa yo wuok chiengʼ.
kaachiel gi mwandugi duto kod ngamia.
Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nigi paro marach kuomu;
Anake joge mantie kuma bor e tunge piny
kendo anakelnegi masira koa koni gi koni,"
Ma e wach Jehova Nyasaye mane obirone janabi Jeremia kuom Elam, e ndalo chakruok mar loch Zedekia ruodh Juda:
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, wacho:
Anamonj Elam gi yembe angʼwen moa
anakegi e yembe angʼwen-go kendo onge piny ma
Anami Elam ongʼengʼ e nyim wasike,
e nyim jogo madwaro tieko ngimagi;
